name: AutomationDirect KN-ECMGRY terminal end cover
aliases: AutomationDirect KN-ECMGRY terminal end cover GA
summary: KN-ECMGRY terminal end cover arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: KN-ECMGRY is the drawing identifier for terminal end cover in AutomationDirect's Konnect-It DIN-Rail Terminal Blocks collection. An end cover closes the exposed side of the compatible terminal arrangement. It is different from an end bracket that mechanically locates the strip.

For example, in a field-terminal strip with a defined end and accessible marking, use the KN-ECMGRY reference to coordinate terminal side face, neighbouring end restraint and marking. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Other PLC Products/Konnect-It/KN-ECMGRY.DWG, Other PLC Products/Konnect-It/KN-ECMBLU.dwg, Other PLC Products/Konnect-It/KN-ECMGRN.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep terminal side face, neighbouring end restraint and marking visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named KN-ECMGRY drawing and its terminal end cover role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
